title: Princess Life Doodle Clipart
author: ann-watercolor
description:
Princess life illustrations in doodle style, black outline. Clipart contains cute illustrations of two princesses and things for fairytale life such as a castle, a coach, a unicorn, evening dresses, jewelry and so on. You can use these illustrations for coloring, creating your own greeting cards, posters and patterns. There are also 7 seamless patterns in this collection. They are great for wrapping papers, wallpapers, covers.
 You will receive:*
•          56 single elements – 56 PNG files with transparent backgrounds and 56 JPG files 300 DPI (size –please see the photo)
•          1 PSD file with all single elements (each image is on a separate layer)
•          1 EPS10 file with all single elements (each image is on a separate layer)
•          1 SVG file with all single elements (each image is on a separate layer)
•          7 seamless patterns- 7 JPG (300 DPI,4000×4000 px), 7 SVG and 7 EPS10 (vector seamless patterns with clipping mask)
•          1 garland with keys – PNG transparent background, JPG 300 DPI, SVG
•          1 square frame – 4000×4000 px, PNG file with transparent backgrounds, JPG file 300 DPI, SVG
If you want to resize images (to make them larger without losing quality) use, please, the vector files –EPS10 and SVG.
Have a nice day and thank you for visiting!
Anna
*This is a digital download of one zip with all images, you won’t receive a physical product.
